classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that catches exceptions during HTTP request processing and returns appropriate JSON error responses.

methods.name: .ctor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next RequestDelegate in the pipeline.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main middleware method invoked per HTTP request, catches exceptions and delegates to exception handler.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Private method that processes exceptions, sets HTTP status codes, and writes error details in JSON format.
